__comment: TFC replacement for MineColonies' vanilla strip_logs/strip_stems lumberjack recipes (those are removed programmatically; see com.mctfc.crafting.LumberjackRecipes). For every TFC log (tfc:wood/log/<wood>, matched via #minecraft:logs + the tfc:wood/log/ path filter) the lumberjack can produce the stripped log, the wood (all-bark) block, or the stripped wood — mirroring the vanilla 1-log -> {stripped_log, wood, stripped_wood} behaviour. Path substitution swaps the wood/log/ form segment; non-existent forms are pruned by MineColonies.
